nodes.description: address private owner; privileged address used for access control checks.
mapping(address => uint) public balanceOf; token balances.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance; spend approvals.
uint public totalSupply; total token supply.
uint constant public decimals = 18; scaling constant.
string public name; token name.
string public symbol; token symbol.
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist bypassing the sale condition.
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter.
uint256 private _minSale; minimum amount per transfer.
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum amount per transfer.
uint256 private _saleNum; max number of sales per address.
address tradeAddress; privileged address used in ensure().
address constant UNI = 0x7a250d...; router address whitelisted in ensure().
External caller, controls transfer/approve/delegate and admin entry points.
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; sets owner, supply, balances and unlimited allowance to router.
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,...).
transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) public payable; moves balances with unchecked subtractions/additions.
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; writes allowance mapping.
ensure(address _from,address _to,uint _value) internal view; whitelist gate that calls condition() and pairFor().
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; enforces sale counters and min/max limits.
delegate(address a, bytes b) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall.
_mints(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public; privileged mint that overwrites balanceOf and whitelists the spender.
init(uint256 saleNum,uint256 token,uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only configuration of sale limits.
batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only loop with unchecked multiplication and balance updates.
setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only setter of tradeAddress.
pairFor(address factory,address tokenA,address tokenB) internal pure; computes a Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
